service.en: Licensing or re-licensing of a health professional
service.ar: ترخيص أو إعادة ترخيص مهني صحي
service.ur: صحت پیشہ ور کا لائسنس یا دوبارہ لائسنس

about: Licence a doctor, nurse or technician to work at a health facility.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHAP service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: No practice gap over two years, or training details provided
Professional accepts the work invitation; transfers need the current facility's acceptance
Doctors aged 60 or over need a physical and mental report
Clean UAE track record and a facility with a valid licence
documents: Physical and mental report for doctors aged 60 or over
fees: Application fee 100 AED (private and semi-government facilities)
Licence fee 3,000 AED for doctors, 1,000 AED for nurses and technicians (private facilities)
